description: Recognize text (on-device OCR) in the images and return the lines in reading order with their rects. Limit it with rect and/or imageId. Rects use the relativeTo space when set.

rect.description: A rectangle (top-left corner plus size). Canvas units, or image pixels with relativeTo.

relativeTo.description: Image id from snipaya_get_canvas. When set, all coordinates in this call are pixels of that image as captured (the same pixels you see in snipaya_render of that image).

tabId.description: Target tab id. Defaults to the active tab.

name: snipaya_read_text
title: Read text
